idea-plugin.name: EveryLibs Reflection Assistant
idea-plugin.description:
Reflection-aware autocomplete, navigation and rename for the EveryLibs reflection library.

Inside the member-name string of a recognized lookup call, pressing completion offers the target class's members — exactly like the IDE already does for Class.getDeclaredField("…"):

  • FieldReflection.getField(SomeClass.class, "<caret>") → field names
  • MethodReflection.getMethod(SomeClass.class, "<caret>") → method names
  • ClassReflect.of(SomeClass.class).method("<caret>") → method names
Ctrl-click navigates to the member and Rename updates the string.
